description.value: Paisanos Slice Shop is a neighbourhood pizzeria in downtown Nanaimo specializing in hand-stretched Neapolitan and New York-inspired slices and whole pies, available for pickup only. The creative menu includes offerings like miso bechamel mushroom, hot garlic honey pepperoni, and potato with rosemary and arugula. A straightforward quick-refuel stop for cyclists moving through central Nanaimo.
